bullets.text: twenty-two degrees after a week of thirty. the mountain runs its own weather and doesn't announce it.
duck reached kōya-san okunoin. cedars in rows, a lamp burning in daylight, nobody around to relight it. 🕯️
closed the tab with the route file that's been open since april. left it unsaved out of superstition.
the flat feeling after a long thing ends. not sad. just nothing pulling forward for the first time in months.
arriving is mostly the same shoes.
